instruction: Lead with the signal. Open with the exact trigger—hiring data, a public post, product usage, or a tech stack indicator—in the first sentence. In one sentence, connect that signal to a concrete outcome Vercel enables: faster iteration, reliability at scale, or developer velocity. Skip pleasantries and filler phrases. The CTA must be a single frictionless ask: offer a specific artifact (benchmark, case study, or 15-min scoped call) rather than a generic meeting request. Total body: under 100 words. Subject line: seven words or fewer, signal-specific, no questions.

demos.leadContext: Rita Alvarez is Head of Web Platform at OrbitIQ. Play: Migration Watch. Top signal: App-router migration: Core routes moved from CRA to Next.js. Play context: public repos moved from CRA to Next.js. Why now: Migration commits accelerated this month and deployment choices are next. Confidence: Concrete migration activity.

topSignal.label: App-router migration
topSignal.value: Core routes moved from CRA to Next.js.

draft.subject: OrbitIQ migration: deployment checklist
draft.body:
Hi Rita,

Saw OrbitIQ move key repos from CRA to Next.js recently. Teams usually hit the same friction right after this step: cache policy, preview discipline, and environment parity.

Happy to share a short migration checklist if useful.

— Alex
